notes.title: March 3, 2023 Bug Fix Update
notes.content:
v1.1.29 
Several bug fixes in DLC "Episode Yamato".
-Fixed bug where the first achievement in the DLC cannot be unlocked.
-Fixed bug where Yamato's hands aren't displayed correctly when played on Valve Index.

In addition to that, we made adjustments to the blackout area to fit the Valve Index's Field of View.

tags.bug: -Fixed bug where the first achievement in the DLC cannot be unlocked.
-Fixed bug where Yamato's hands aren't displayed correctly when played on Valve Index.
